title: Count Set Bits
description:
## Task

Count the 1 bits in the binary form of a non-negative integer.

## Input

- `n` — a non-negative integer.

## Output

An integer: how many binary digits of `n` are 1.

## Example

```python
count_set_bits(10)  # returns 2
count_set_bits(64)  # returns 1
```

## Constraints

- 0 ≤ `n` < 2^63
